excerpt.zh: 我们探测到了奇怪的宇宙射线，科学专员要求对其进行调查。
excerpt.en: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.

texts.zh: 我们探测到了奇怪的宇宙射线，科学专员要求对其进行调查。
texts.en: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.

sections.zh: 我们探测到了奇怪的宇宙射线，科学专员要求对其进行调查。
sections.en: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了有趣的东西，不过跟[From.GetPlanetMoon]本身没有什么关系。我们像往常一样进行测试时，突然捕获到一颗遥远的恒星系中的恒星传出的奇怪数据。该恒星的辐射表明，它可以在不发生散裂的情况下让铍原子发生聚变，而这根本就是不可能的！

科学团队已经迫不及待想前去一探究竟了，而且他们已经将范围缩小到两个不是很远的恒星系。
查询情报日志获取细节。
texts.en:
We have made an interesting find on [From.GetName], however it is not related to the [From.GetPlanetMoon] itself. While conducting our usual tests we captured some odd data from a far-off system's star. Its radiation indicates that it is able to fuse together beryllium without spallation; something that should not be possible!

The science team are eager to investigate and have limited the potential stars down to two not-too-distant systems.
Consult the Situation Log for details.

label.zh: 这可能会带来丰厚的收获。

label.en: We don't have time for this.

texts.en: In search for odd radiation readings.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的离子辐射强度已经爆表了。看起来[From.GetPlanetMoon]似乎最近受到了核弹头的轰炸，或者是暴露在了可能是从附近超新星所发出的聚集射线束之中。至于后者是否能够造成这种效果，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]毫无头绪。
texts.en: The ionizing radiation on [From.GetName] is off the charts. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] seems to either have been bombarded with nuclear warheads quite recently or been exposed to a concentrated beam of cosmic rays, perhaps from a nearby supernova. How the latter could ever be achieved is beyond Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName].
